{{Top|leg}}
An '''Immigrant Droid chip''' was a required form for any [[Droid/Legends|droids]] taken to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Algara II]] by their owners. Each chip required the name and model of the droid, along with skills and attachments. Each chip cost five [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], and each droid was issued with a small bolt marker identifying them as a legal visitor to the world.
